statement: In the spherical Artin monoid of type D_4 with S_1={sigma'_0,sigma_1} and S_2={sigma_0,sigma_1,sigma_2}, the (S_2,S_1)-alternating normal form of the standard Garside element is (sigma_2 sigma_0, sigma_1 sigma'_0, sigma_0 sigma_1 sigma_2 sigma_1 sigma_0, sigma'_0 sigma_1 sigma'_0). Hence L*(Delta,S)={sigma_0,sigma_2}=Phi_Delta(S_2 boxminus S_1), and for every p,t>=1, dpt(Delta^(pt))-1=t(dpt(Delta^p)-1); equivalently, the covering satisfies Condition A with respect to every Delta^p.
contribution: A complete exact resolution of the frozen D_4 case: four certified greatest parabolic right tails give the alternating normal form, an exact left-descent calculation gives L*, and the source's Corollary 4.7 implication plus substitution proves the universally quantified all-powers consequence.
